Name: CP - Mac Daddy Pierre
Author: AmuTsukiyomi
Description:
Pierre's always thought he was hot stuff.  Now with this new summer look, he can look like the Mac Daddy he thinks he is -  in what I feel is Pierre's classic  style: not quite understanding what is "cool".

With help from [color=#e69138][b]MinervaMaga[/b][/color] and [color=#e69138][b]Pathoschild[/b][/color], I have attempted to give this mod a Config.  I was only somewhat successful, as it does have a config, but for some reason it currently still changes Pierre's clothes all the time even though the default is Summer only.  I'll fix this later...or at least I'll try.  [s]For now, it's a not really functional config file.[/s]

[color=#6d9eeb][size=4][b]THANK YOU MINERVA![/b][/size][/color]
The config is fixed!

Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher.

[color=#ff0000][b]ASK TO USE MY SPRITES for other stuff, otherwise the answer is a default [i][u]ABSOLUTELY NO.[/u][/i][/b][/color]
